name: Medspa Bella
address: 2368 Sunset Point Rd, Clearwater, FL 33763, United States

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Samantha Malcolm
reviewSamples.text: I booked an appointment for yesterday that was cancelled due to unforeseen circumstances which I completely understood so I booked a new appointment for today. I showed up to my appointment on time to find no one there and no one picking up the phone. I don’t understand why an appointment would be accepted if it can’t be fulfilled. I should’ve listened to the previous review that experienced the same issue. This is incredibly unprofessional and disappointing seeing as I was prepared to get quite a few different procedures done here. Don’t waste your time on this “business”.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Stacy Morales
reviewSamples.text: Unfortunately I can’t review on the emsculpt service I booked because no one showed up to the office. My appointment was for 10am, and I waited for 10 mins after in case they were running late. I called twice and texted and received no reply. Disappointing way to run a business.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Marta
reviewSamples.text:
Jeisan is a top notch specialist in her area.
She took care of me after I had liposuction procedure done.
Her lymphatic drainage massage helped with all bruises and swollen from lipo.
I have know her since 2018 and I highly recommend her services. You will be pleased.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Ludimila Couto
reviewSamples.text: I'm so happy with Jeisan and her services. Always very professional with such good job. I can't wait to the next appointment.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Izabeli Rocha
reviewSamples.text: I love this place! Jeisan is a very capable and attentive professional. The Spa is always very clean and pleasant and services are wonderful.
